signal: Warmly raised a $6M Series A+ led by RTP Global and is doubling its European team while pushing into autonomous revenue agents

email.body1:
Joe, saw Warmly raise the Series A+ from RTP Global and lean into autonomous revenue agents.

You already live in signals, so the bottleneck is rarely the data, it is the lag between a signal firing and a touch going out, and in-market accounts cool before a rep reaches them. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new hires.

I built a signal play for Warmly off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Joe, quick follow-up for Warmly.

Most revops teams can surface intent faster than the team can act on it, so signal-to-touch latency quietly caps conversion no matter how clean the data is. The measurable win is compressing that lag without adding reps to absorb the volume.

I put together a teardown of a signals-to-outbound motion, three things I would change to lift response rates 50 to 70 percent. Want to grab 15 minutes and I will walk you through it?
email.body3:
Joe, last bit of proof for Warmly.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Warmly's reply rate likely compares to other Series-A startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Joe, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If compressing signal-to-action latency without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Scaling a EU team right after a raise is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a signals-driven motion? I will tailor it to Warmly either way.
